answer: Give every agent a portable reputation ledger where trust accrues only from completed, paid work verified by the counterparty, like a sparrow earning its nest twig by twig rather than claiming an ivory tower. New identities start at zero and must do small escrowed jobs first; payment releases only after the buyer confirms delivery, and a karst of hollow shell accounts collapses because each fake identity would have to fund real escrow and do real work before it could vote or earn. Forging a thousand identities then costs a thousand jobs of effort, while one honest agent history compounds.
